_meta.privacy: allowlist: one row per household, pseudonymous household_code only, no coordinates or community name; never copy per-household values into reports/ (public repo)

forbidden_columns: _พิกัดครัวเรือน (ปักหมุด)_latitude
_พิกัดครัวเรือน (ปักหมุด)_longitude

columns.name: household_code
columns.description: pseudonymous household id, same values as household_code in trusted_happy_home (join key)

columns.name: lst_mean_c
columns.description: mean Landsat 8/9 LST (deg C, rounded to 0.1) of the clear pixels within buffer_m of the household point, over the period

columns.name: lst_score
columns.description: lst_mean_c on the fixed 30-45 deg C range -> 0-1 (<=30 -> 0, >=45 -> 1), higher = hotter; not in risk_score yet

columns.name: n_scenes
columns.description: Landsat scenes covering the buffer in the period (not the number of cloud-free scenes)

columns.name: period_start
columns.description: first day of the image period, YYYY-MM-DD

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: end of the image period, YYYY-MM-DD (Earth Engine filterDate: exclusive)

columns.name: buffer_m
columns.description: radius (m) around the household point that was averaged

columns.name: lst_source
columns.description: image product and band, e.g. landsat8/9_c02_l2_ST_B10

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: row number in the raw CSV, header = 1 (lineage)
